import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import zipfile

root = Path.cwd()
data = root / "knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm"
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
read = lambda path: json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
candidate = read(data / "ipm-v58-identity.json")
parent = read(data / "ipm-v57-identity.json")
audit = read(data / "v58-verification.json")
plan = read(data / "v58-plan.json")
assert audit["passed"] is True and audit["gate"]["eligible_for_netlib"] is False
assert audit["identity_sha256"] == sha(data / "ipm-v58-identity.json")
assert sha(data / "ipm-v57-identity.json") == plan["parent_identity_sha256"]
assert all(sha(root / name) == digest for name, digest in candidate["files"].items())
changed = sorted(name for name in parent["files"] if parent["files"][name] != candidate["files"][name])
assert changed == sorted(plan["changed_source_files"]) and len(changed) == 5
destination = data / "v58-restored-source.json"
assert not destination.exists()
archive = data / "ipm-v57-source.zip"
assert sha(archive) == parent["source_zip_sha256"]
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as stored:
    restored = {name: stored.read(name) for name in changed}
assert all(hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() == parent["files"][name] for name, content in restored.items())
# 只恢复本轮已核对的五份源码；原有工作和冻结实验产物保持。
for name, content in restored.items():
    target = (root / name).resolve()
    assert target.is_relative_to(root.resolve())
    target.write_bytes(content)
actual = {name: sha(root / name) for name in parent["files"]}
assert actual == parent["files"]
result = {"passed": True, "created_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          "verification_sha256": sha(data / "v58-verification.json"),
          "restored_version": "ipm-cpu-0.47.0", "restored_files": changed,
          "source_files": len(actual), "files": actual,
          "scope": "源码逐字恢复v57；此记录不代表恢复后的构建及测试已经执行"}
with destination.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as target:
    json.dump(result, target, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    target.write("\n")
print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in result.items() if key != "files"}, ensure_ascii=False))
